eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Applicant/Beneficiary must  be registered with labor department.
1. Only family member will able to get the death benefits:

  - Depended parents.
  - Spouse (Husband/Wife).
  - Daughter.
  - Son ( Only If below 21 years old)

1. Death benefit will not be applicable in the case of suicide. 
1. Deaths due to murder, snakebite, lightning, childbirth and other natural calamities will be considered as normal deaths and benefits will be admissible accordingly.
1. In death benefit claim of a construction worker, Aadhaar authentication of the dependent will be required if the dependent applies.

children.text: The Nirman Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayata Yojana Uttar Pradesh is a crucial scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh government for the welfare of registered construction workers in the state.
